title: friction-trial
description: One appended line of the friction trial record, written by `harness friction patterns --record <file>` (ticket 192). The record is the keep-or-remove evidence for the kind/repeats feature: one line per weekly listing run, so that if nothing ever reaches the threshold in 4 weekly records, Governance removes the fields. The crate is the only writer; a reader checks the four keys and nothing else.

date.description: The UTC calendar date of the listing run, written by the harness, never caller-supplied.

threshold.description: The N in force for this run: `friction.pattern_threshold` from the config, or the default 3 when the key is absent.

rows.description: Every row the inbox held at the run (friction rows included): the denominator that shows how small the feature's footprint is.

listed.description: The ids of the chain-root pattern rows whose repeat count reached the threshold, in id order. Ids only: a row's text is never recorded.
